description: Kernel/module compatibility evidence for the stock rothko kernel and its stock module sets. This does not claim a runtime module load or boot test.

crc_cross_check.method: Parse __versions (struct modversion_info) from every module. Compare vendor-module symbol CRCs against the system_dlkm GKI module map, whose vermagic matches the boot kernel release.

conclusion: All 564 stock modules contain __versions, share the same vermagic suffix (SMP preempt mod_unload modversions aarch64) and the same module_layout CRC 0xea759d7f. Under same_magic(has_crcs=true) the release prefix is ignored, so the git hash difference alone is not a rejection reason. Vendor-vs-system_dlkm __versions CRC overlaps are consistent. The kernel symbol CRC table was not located in the stripped image and no runtime load was performed; compatibility remains unverified, not declared incompatible.
limitations: The kernel __kcrctab/CRC data may be present in the stripped image but was not located; this is not a claim that it is absent.
Only module-to-GKI-module __versions CRC consistency and module_layout CRC equality are proven; per-symbol CRC comparison against the real running kernel is still required.
No module was loaded and no phone access occurred.

same_magic.note: With __versions present, same_magic skips the release prefix and compares only the suffix. The git hash difference is therefore not a rejection reason.

kernel_symbol_crc_table_status: not located in the stripped Image.elf; __kcrctab may be present, so absence is not claimed
